name: MRI Scanner
instruction: Design an MRI scanner. Start with a large cylindrical tunnel where the patient lies down. Add a sliding table that moves in and out of the tunnel. Include a control panel with various buttons and screens on the side. Add a few cables connecting the scanner to the control panel. Finally, ensure there is an emergency stop button on the control panel.

The scanner features a large cylindrical tunnel.
The sliding table is integrated into the design.
The control panel is positioned on the side of the scanner.
The cables are visible connecting the scanner to the control panel.

The sliding table is correctly aligned to move in and out of the tunnel.
The control panel is mounted at a reachable height on the side.
The cables are arranged to avoid interference with the sliding table.
Object distance and contact: The sliding table fits snugly within the tunnel without obstruction.
There is sufficient space between the control panel and the scanner for operation.
The cables do not create a tripping hazard around the scanner.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified components are accurately represented.
